hook: AI gave me a 47-step plan when I asked how to fix my morning routine.
caption:
AI gave me a 47-step plan when I asked how to fix my morning routine.

I asked for help. I got a project manager's nightmare.

Here's the thing nobody talks about: AI doesn't know if you're the kind of person who needs a 3-bullet summary or a 12-page breakdown. It doesn't know if you want the theory first or just tell me what to DO. It defaults to... everything. Just in case.

So you get the 47-step plan.

Or the essay when you wanted a list.

Or the gentle, diplomatic response when you actually needed someone to be blunt with you.

This isn't an AI problem. It's a *calibration* problem.

The model is smart. It just doesn't know how YOUR brain works.

BootFile fixes this by building a profile of your thinking style — how you process information, how direct you want feedback, whether you think in systems or stories — and giving AI that context before you even type your first word.

Same question. Completely different answer.

I got 3 bullets. They actually worked.

If you've ever copy-pasted an AI response and deleted 80% of it, this is why.
